news.headline: FLOOD WATCH — NWS Melbourne: Orange, Osceola, Seminole, Brevard & Volusia, Tue 5 PM through Fri 7 PM — 3–6 in. of rain, isolated 8–12 in.; Flood Warning for St. Johns River near Cocoa and Astor
Florida single-family closed sales fell 10.1% in October to 19,049; median price rose 2.2% to $420,000, new contracts dropped 15.7%
Central Florida new construction: 2,919 active listings across Orange, Seminole, Osceola, Lake & Polk on Nov 16 — Polk most at 1,071, median $333,415
Sarasota County votes Nov 18 on 1,000 more homes at Palmer Ranch East — up to 5,702 homes total
Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31 — permit application date governs which edition applies; flood documentation and coastal corrosion rules among the changes
Copper trading at $5.97/lb Tue, consolidating near $5.88 support — AI data-center and grid-upgrade demand cited as structural driver
Markets Mon: S&P 500 fell 1.92% to 7,417 and Nasdaq fell 2.49% as the 10-year yield reached 5.15%; Fed held at 3.75–4.00%, October minutes due Wed
Florida workers' comp: OIR approved NCCI's −7.4% average rate cut for new and renewal policies from Jan 1, 2027
NBA Mon: Magic 115, Celtics 105 — Orlando's 4th straight win, Bane 24 pts · Heat 128, Rockets 110 — Miami's 5th straight win
NFL Week 11 Sun: Jaguars (7–2) at Giants · Buccaneers (3–6) at Lions · Dolphins (1–8) at Bills
